subject: English Home Language

show.line: Let's write b. A tall line down, then back up and round the tummy. b, b, baby!

rounds.prompt: Tap the letter that says b, as in baby.
This letter says b. Say the sound!
Trace b with your finger. Tall line down, back up, then round.
Look carefully. Which one is b? The tummy is on the right.

hints: b has a tall line first, then a round tummy.
Start at the top. Go all the way down first.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write b for baby.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Round tummy first, then a line up. Look, I wrote b!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is d. b starts with the tall line.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Look together. Tall line down, then round. That is b!

parent_line: Can recognise the letter b, say its sound and trace it.
